title: Scenario 2: specialist input and revision
purpose: A higher-value draft with seven deviations needs a privacy specialist, a clarification from the requester, a revision cycle with a reopened issue and a re-approval after the matter changes.

matter.title: Enterprise SaaS MSA deviation review (synthetic)
matter.summary: A prospective enterprise customer returned our SaaS MSA with a higher liability cap, an unrestricted audit right, a subprocessor ban, a dated roadmap commitment and most-favoured-customer pricing.

facts.requested_deviations: 300% liability cap; audit at any time; no subprocessors; roadmap delivery date; most-favoured-customer pricing; 90 day payment terms

intake.instructions: The deal is strategic. Finance accepts ninety day payment terms for this customer. A liability cap above 100% needs General Counsel approval.

steps.say: The requester opens the matter but leaves the business owner blank: four of five required facts.
Submission is refused and names the missing fact. This first attempt is what the intake-completeness measure counts.
A new fact is a substantive change, so the system keeps version 1 and creates version 2 with a fresh assessment.
The intake is now complete.
Parent routing: medium risk, priority P2, approval chain up to General Counsel. The subprocessor rule requires Privacy Counsel.
The owner assigns the privacy specialist.
The owner assigns the General Counsel as final approver.
Readiness check: the specialist has not completed onboarding, so review cannot start.
The specialist completes the three onboarding tasks for the role.
The readiness check passes and review opens.
Stop the process. Review continues in a new process.
An internal review draft is written for reading in Word. Every file is marked as a draft and it is stored apart from delivery packages.
Audit right: standard position.

args.reason: Finance accepts ninety day payment terms for this customer, as recorded in the requester's instructions.

steps.say: Payment terms: the proposed change is rejected, which accepts the customer's wording as an exception. A reason is mandatory.
Missing exclusion of indirect loss: the standard clause is inserted.
Most-favoured-customer clause: deleted.
Roadmap commitment: replaced by the informational statement.

args.reason: Does Finance accept a 200% cap for all claims, or only the standard 100%?

steps.say: Liability cap: the owner needs a fact from the business and asks the requester. The clock for waiting on the business starts.
Unauthorised decision: the owner tries to decide the privacy clause. Only Privacy Counsel may.
The privacy specialist accepts the standard subprocessor clause.

args.resolution: Order summary table read by the matter owner; it contains no contract terms.

args.body: The data map must list workspace metadata before signature.

steps.say: Conflicting edits: the owner and the specialist both act on the revision they loaded. The owner's write lands; the specialist's is refused as stale and nothing is overwritten.

args.body: The data map must list workspace metadata before signature.

steps.say: The specialist reloads and resubmits the comment.

args.note: Subprocessor clause follows the playbook; no privacy objection on this version.

steps.say: The specialist signs off. The sign-off is bound to version 2.

args.note: Approving now so the deal desk can move ahead this week.

steps.say: The approver tries to approve early. Refused: one change is undecided and a clarification is open.
Stop the process overnight. The open clarification and every decision must still be there.

args.body: Finance accepts 200% for all claims on this deal; confirmed by the finance lead on the deal call.

steps.say: The requester answers the clarification with a supporting note. Waiting on the business ends.

args.resolution: Finance position confirmed by the requester: 200% for all claims.

steps.say: The owner, who asked, resolves the clarification.

args.reason: Fallback position: 200% cap agreed with Finance for this strategic customer.

steps.say: Liability cap: amended to the fallback. Original, proposed and amended wording are all kept with the reason.

args.body: The ninety day payment exception needs a Finance confirmation on file before I approve.

steps.say: The approver raises a critical comment on the accepted-exceptions section of the deliverable.

args.note: Do not present the payment exception without Finance evidence.

steps.say: The approver requests a revision and names the comment it concerns.
Unauthorised decision: the owner tries to close a critical comment on their own work. Only its author or the final approver may.

args.body: Finance confirmation note attached for the payment terms exception.

steps.say: The owner responds with evidence. This is correction effort.

args.note: Finance confirmation added to the payment exception.

steps.say: The owner submits the revision.
The approver resumes review.

args.resolution: Finance note received and filed with the matter.

steps.say: The approver resolves the comment.

args.reason: The Finance note covers sixty days, not ninety.

steps.say: Reopened issue: on reading the note the approver sees it covers sixty days only and reopens the comment.

args.body: Corrected Finance note for ninety days attached.

steps.say: The owner supplies the corrected note.

args.resolution: Corrected Finance note for ninety days received and filed.

steps.say: The approver resolves the comment for good.
The requester changes a fact. Version 3 is created and reassessed, the specialist's sign-off on version 2 is invalidated, unchanged change decisions carry forward, and the matter moves to revised.

args.note: All comments resolved and exceptions evidenced; approving the reviewed draft.

steps.say: Stale approval: the approver tries to approve what they reviewed before the change. Approval is not reachable from revised.
The owner resumes review on version 3.

args.note: All comments resolved and exceptions evidenced; approving the reviewed draft.

steps.say: Still refused: the privacy sign-off belongs to version 2.

args.note: Re-reviewed on version 3: only the signature date changed; no privacy objection.

steps.say: The specialist signs off on version 3.

args.note: All comments resolved and exceptions evidenced; approving version 3 of the reviewed draft.

steps.say: The approver approves version 3 and its reviewed state.
Library bypass after approval: a stateless caller still gets no delivery package; only the store-backed path can supply the reviewer decisions.
The gate passes for version 3 and the delivery package is written locally.
Stop the process. The package and its manifest must verify after a restart.

args.note: Package received; obligations and deadlines understood by the account team.

steps.say: The requester accepts the package. The matter closes.
